title.value: Deep Active Learning: Unified and Principled Method for Query and Training
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning and end of the paper.
title.quote: Deep Active Learning: Unified and Principled Method for Query and Training

analysis.description: This paper proposes a unified method for querying and training in deep batch active learning using Wasserstein distance for distribution matching. It introduces a new training loss for DNNs that leverages unlabeled data for optimization and supports a hybrid query strategy combining uncertainty and diversity.

type.justification: The paper focuses on developing a theoretical framework for active learning using Wasserstein distance, suggesting a new training loss and query strategy.
type.quote: We derived the theoretical analysis through modeling the interactive procedure in AL as distribution matching by adopting the Wasserstein distance.

name.justification: The paper centers around enhancing the active learning process, particularly using theoretical insights like distribution matching with Wasserstein distance.
name.quote: In this paper, we are proposing a unified and principled method for both the querying and training processes in deep batch active learning.

name.justification: The methodology and experiments are grounded in the context of deep learning systems, employing neural network models.
name.quote: Deep neural networks (DNNs) achieved unprecedented success for many supervised learning tasks such as image classification and object detection.

name.justification: The focus on theoretical frameworks and loss functions in machine learning places this paper in the realm of machine learning theory.
name.quote: Then inspired by [Arjovsky et al., 2017], we extend the loss to the deep representation learning scenario.

name.quote: For the tasks on SVHN, CIFAR-10 we implement VGG16... as the feature extractor.
